card.name: Steady, continuous, or basal wording
card.fires_on: Words meaning steady or always-on, such as continuous, constant, basal and base load, and the middle of insulin glargine. Mostly in insulin dosing text and technical writing.

modes.label: Basal and continuous
modes.description: Words for a steady background level, like basal insulin or continuous wave.

modes.label: Inside insulin glargine
modes.description: The 'arg' piece in the middle of the drug name glargine.
modes.example: SOLIQUA 100/33 is a combination of insulin gl<<arg>>ine and lixisenatide.

modes.label: Constant or base load
modes.description: Adjectives or nouns for unbroken or baseline supply or pain.
modes.example: the pain may be throbbing or<< constant>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like routine, permanent and continuous, suggesting an ongoing, regular state.
